## Expected and actual behavior

## Evidence

Paste only relevant error lines in a code block. Remove account tokens, private addresses and personal information. Do not attach launcher account files or an entire unfiltered log.

## Checks performed

Unchecked items are useful information too; you do not need to check everything to report a bug.
